items.stem: When a parent acquires a subsidiary, goodwill at acquisition is calculated as:

options.text: Consideration plus non-controlling interest, less the fair value of net identifiable assets
options.rationale: Correct: goodwill is the excess of consideration plus NCI over the fair value of net identifiable assets acquired.

options.text: Consideration less the book value of the subsidiary's share capital
options.rationale: Book value and share capital alone ignore fair values and NCI.

options.text: The subsidiary's retained earnings at acquisition
options.rationale: Retained earnings are not goodwill; goodwill is a residual over net assets.

options.text: Consideration less the subsidiary's total liabilities
options.rationale: Liabilities alone are not the measurement base for goodwill.

items.explanation: Correct: goodwill is the excess of consideration plus NCI over the fair value of net identifiable assets acquired.

items.stem: An entity has a taxable temporary difference because an asset's carrying amount exceeds its tax base. This gives rise to:

options.rationale: Correct: a taxable temporary difference (carrying amount above tax base) creates a deferred tax liability.
A deductible temporary difference, not a taxable one, creates a deferred tax asset.
Temporary differences affect deferred tax, not an immediate current refund.
A taxable temporary difference does have a deferred tax effect.

items.explanation: Correct: a taxable temporary difference (carrying amount above tax base) creates a deferred tax liability.

items.stem: Select TWO items that are typically eliminated on consolidation of a parent and its subsidiary.

options.text: Intragroup sales and purchases between the two entities
options.rationale: Correct: intragroup trading is eliminated to avoid double counting.

options.text: Unrealised profit in closing inventory from intragroup sales
options.rationale: Correct: unrealised profit on inventory still held within the group is eliminated.

options.text: Sales made by the subsidiary to external customers
options.rationale: Genuine external sales are not eliminated.

options.text: The parent's dividend paid to its own external shareholders
options.rationale: External dividends are not intragroup items.

options.text: Salaries paid to the group's employees
options.rationale: Employee salaries are normal expenses, not intragroup eliminations.

items.explanation: Correct: intragroup trading is eliminated to avoid double counting.
